_comment: Model class name -> ppe_types.code in the backend. Lookup ignores case, accents and separators, so 'Capacete', 'capacete' and 'CAPACETE' are one entry, as are 'safety vest' and 'Safety_Vest'. Classes absent from this file are ignored and logged once. Never map a negative class such as 'sem-capacete': the backend infers absence from what is missing, and mapping it would report the equipment as present.
